scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable friction, 9 excellent with minor issues, 10 exceptional within assessed scope. Overall is a holistic judgment, not the mission outcome or arithmetic average.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent, visually distinctive mission with useful touch assistance and objective feedback, held back by inconsistent apparent target centering, obstruction ambiguity and dense text at 844x390. Two wins do not by themselves establish quality or enjoyment.
reasons.controls: Large anchored controls, tap aim, MOVE and two-contact FIRE worked in sampled situations. DASH feedback was clear. Route-facing changes and the right-side target tap complicated aiming. Brief drags do not establish fine control quality.
reasons.gameplay: Receiver recovery, armor windows, numbered coils and final upload formed a legible progression; managing rear pressure while focusing forward added observed tension. Route assistance dominated navigation and enabled substantial bypass of patrol combat, limiting assessment of manual traversal and sustained encounters.
reasons.presentation: Strong rainy industrial atmosphere, restrained cyan/amber palette and coherent title/result layouts. Judged visually only; audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Visible fresh restart, paused map with completion markers, recovery confirmations and progress percentages reduced uncertainty. Empty-magazine reload required a FIRE action in the observed run; cover outcomes were sometimes difficult to diagnose.
reasons.readability: Core health/ammo/buttons and coil states readable; small environmental signage, compact hints, dense handbook and overlay competition strained the narrow landscape view. Handbook lower text was clipped behind its scroll area; it invited swiping but I did not fully scroll it.
